description: This file defines the class S3ExpressIdentityProvider which provides an identity provider for Amazon S3, including methods for caching credentials and creating S3 sessions.

classes.name: S3ExpressIdentityProvider
classes.description: Provides identity management for S3 sessions with caching capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the provider with a region and optional configuration, and sets up a cache.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Handles providing or creating an S3 identity based on a bucket command, utilizing caching for efficiency.

methods.name: getS3Client
methods.description: Lazy-loads and returns an S3 client instance, configured with provided settings or default parameters.
